candidates.reason: The headline breaks badly ('Mara / Quill / on The / Quiet / Hours') and dwarfs everything else. The 'AUTHOR EVENING' kicker is microscopic above a shrunken logo. The book art is a tiny, illegible thumbnail. The badges are oversized pills stacked below the CTA, so they compete with it and break the reading order.

The logo and the kicker are squeezed side by side at the top. The headline wraps awkwardly ('on / The / Quiet / Hours'). The venue text is crammed into a narrow column next to the shrunken book. The badges are scattered down the canvas with big gaps after the CTA, so they no longer read as one group.

This is just the original shrunk into the middle band, with huge empty areas above and below. All body copy, badges, CTA and legal text are illegibly tiny, and the venue line and badges look clipped by the book circle. It does not adapt to the format at all.

The CTA crowds the bottom of the circle, and the body copy is cramped.
